facts.fact: MZ News reports that on 20 February 2026 the Mozambique-Zambia Interconnectivity Project was launched at Cassacatiza with Zambia's science and technology minister present, a cross-border fibre partnership of Vodacom Moçambique and Bayobab Zambia with both countries' regulators involved.

note: Launch ceremony only; works begun or in service not stated.
